name: airport-data 1.0.1 (OpenFlights-derived)
note: IATA and ICAO airport codes are published identifiers, not a curated word list, which
is why `airline.airport` is sourced while airline and aircraft names are left to the
bootstrap: those are trademarks and no permissive registry publishes them.
OurAirports is the fuller community database and is public domain, but it publishes a
continuously-updated CSV at an unversioned URL with no releases -- the same problem as
GeoNames dumps and the NHTSA API. This is a versioned, dependency-free npm release of
the OpenFlights data, pinnable by integrity hash. One layer removed, and verifiable.
Unlicense is a public-domain dedication, so there is no attribution obligation.
